description: Margaret was seen to slip while transferring from the armchair at 09:35. Staff were present but unable to prevent the fall.
immediate_actions: Assessed in situ for injury before moving. Neurological observations commenced. Senior carer and nurse in charge informed.
outcome: Monitoring continued; no further deterioration in the following 24 hours.
lessons_learned: Fall occurred during an unsupervised transfer; call bell was in reach but not used.
preventative_actions: Falls risk assessment reviewed. Hourly checks continued and mobility aid position reinforced with the resident and staff.
